title: Unlocking the Future of Local OTT Advertising: And How to Monetize It - The NAB Podcast | iHeart

facts.fact: The NAB Podcast episode 'Unlocking the Future of Local OTT Advertising: And How to Monetize It' was published May 12, 2022 and runs 27 minutes.
The episode was recorded live at the 2022 NAB Show.
facts.quote: Recorded LIVE at the 2022 NAB Show!

facts.fact: Shawn Makhijani, senior vice president of Business Development and Strategy at NBCUniversal Television and Streaming and senior vice president of NBC Spot On, is the guest on the episode discussing local OTT advertising.
facts.quote: Shawn Makhijani, senior vice president of Business Development and Strategy, NBCUniversal Television and Streaming, and senior vice president, NBC Spot On

facts.fact: In a March 14, 2022 episode, Townsquare Media CEO Bill Wilson said that creating and investing in digital verticals in markets 50+ is consistently paying dividends.
facts.quote: creating and investing in digital verticals in markets 50+ is consistently paying dividends
